_comment: Ratchet baseline for CLAUDE.md section 4 gates that cannot pass yet. These counts may only DECREASE. Raising a number is a regression and must be rejected in review. Delete an entry once its gate is clean, and make that gate hard-blocking.

_targets.credo_issues: reduced opportunistically; no slice owns it yet
_targets.dialyzer_warnings: no slice owns reduction yet; gate is ratcheted
_targets.hex_audit_advisories: advisory only; no ratchet yet -- see BACKLOG

_method.test_failures: sum of 'N failures' across umbrella apps in `mix test`
_method.credo_issues: sum of all FIVE credo summary categories in `mix credo --strict`
_method.hex_audit_advisories: count of '^  <pkg> <version>' lines in `mix hex.audit` (superset of deps.audit)
_method.deps_audit_advisories: count of '^Name:' lines in `mix do deps.loadpaths + deps.audit`

_retired.reason: Reached 0 in slice 13 and held there. This file's own _comment says to delete a clean entry and make that gate hard-blocking; this is that deletion. tools/gate.sh now scores the test gate with hard_zero -- only 0 passes, and there is no baseline to raise. The _corrections entry recording 2 -> 0 stays: it is the evidence of how the gate got clean, and deleting it would erase the audit trail. A ratchet at 0 was materially weaker than a hard gate, because baseline_gate permits a raise with a matching _corrections entry; that path is now closed for tests. The CI job keeps the name 'Gate - test ratchet' because it is a required status check in ruleset 22066749 and renaming it would leave a required context that never reports; the rename is owner work, tracked in BACKLOG.md.

_corrections.reason: 60 was a mis-measurement: it counted :warn_* atoms excluding warn_unknown, an undocumented method. 61 is dialyzer's own `Total errors` and is what the gate now reads. Raising a baseline is otherwise forbidden; this entry is the audit record that makes the increase reviewable. See FINDINGS.md F3/H5.

Both baseline failures resolved, not suppressed. HacktuiSensorTest: production 5s collector cadence vs a 2s assert_eventually budget; fixed by setting process_signals_interval_ms: 50 in config/test.exs. ReadModelsTest: alert_queue_query/0 was a duplicate, never-executable definition of the alert queue with no production caller (selected entry_type/payload, which AuditEvent does not declare); deleted, with a boundary test in apps/hacktui_hub/test/query_boundary_test.exs asserting one public definition. Suite: 248 tests, 0 failures, three consecutive runs.
